meetings.title: 16th Meeting 2026
meetings.summary: In this meeting, the Committee discussed a letter submitted by the Diabetes Society of Maldives outlining their concerns. The Committee decided to seek further information from the relevant institutions to clarify the issues raised. The institutions to which the Committee decided to send letters are as follows: 1. Ministry of Health, Family and Welfare 2. Aasandha Company ltd 3. National Diabetes centre 4. Indira Gandhi Memorial Hospital This was proposed by Nilandhoo Constituency Member Fathimath Saudha and seconded by Dhaandhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Fazeel. The proposal was unanimously passed by the members present in the committee. Next, the Committee discussed a letter submitted by Ilmuveringe Gulhun regarding the need to prohibit unlawful behaviours that violate Islamic and social norms and to identify an appropriate legal solution to address the issue. Regarding this issue, the Committee decided to seek information from the Malé City Council and the Maldives Police Service on whether they have received any complaints or reports related to this matter, and to obtain relevant statistics. This was proposed by Nilandhoo Constituency Member Fathimath Saudha and seconded by Dhaandhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Fazeel. The proposal was unanimously passed by the members present in the committee. Regarding the same issue, the Committee also decided to send a letter to Ilmuveringe Gulhun stating that the Preventing Actions Contrary to Public Social Standards Act addresses the concerns outlined in the issue they have submitted, as the Act provides the legal framework to prevent actions that violate public social norms and sets out the measures to be taken against individuals who breach such standards. This was proposed by Nilandhoo Constituency Member Fathimath Saudha and seconded by Naifaru Constituency Member Yaseen Abdullah. The proposal was unanimously passed by the members present in the committee. The details of this vote are in the "Votes" section of this page.

meetings.title: 14th Meeting 2026
meetings.summary: In this meeting, the Committee discussed “The resolution submitted by North Galolhu Constituency Member Mohamed Ibrahim to ascertain the views of Members of Parliament on the lack of access to Aasandha healthcare services to foreigners who are married to Maldivians”. Nilandhoo Constituency Member Fathimath Saudha proposed sending letters to the Family Court to obtain statistics on foreigners living in the Maldives who are married to Maldivians, to the Male' City Group of Hospitals to determine the number of such foreigners who have received inpatient treatment, and to Maldives Immigration to get the total number of resident visas issued to foreign nationals. This proposal was seconded by West Maafannu Constituency Member Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim. The proposal was unanimously passed by the members present. As a second matter, the committee discussed a case submitted by a private individual. In connection with this issue, the committee decided to send a letter to Aasandha Company Limited requesting details on how Aasandha handled the matter. As a third matter, the committee discussed a letter sent by a private individual stating that essential treatments required after suffering an eye stroke are unavailable at government hospitals. Regarding this issue, the committee decided to send a letter to the Male' City Group of Hospitals to clarify further relevant information. As a fourth matter, the committee discussed an issue submitted by a private individual concerning the difficulties in accessing medicine in the Maldives. On this matter, the committee decided to send an email to the party who submitted the issue to obtain further details regarding the case. Next, the committee discussed a letter submitted by a private individual stating that acts of corruption were taking place in the process of hiring doctors and nurses at Dr. Abdul Samad Memorial Hospital. Regarding this issue, West Maafannu Constituency member Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim, proposed that since this matter does not appear to fall within the scope of the Social Affairs Committee's mandate, it should be forwarded to the Government Oversight Committee. This proposal was seconded by Dhaandhoo Constituency member Mohamed Fazeel. The proposal was unanimously passed by the members present. As a final matter, the committee discussed a letter sent to the Ministry of Islamic Affairs which was copied to the People's Majlis, regarding the Maldives Hajj Corporation Limited's failure to provide a satisfactory response to a request asking for arrangements to expedite the Hajj pilgrimage for the submitter's due to a medical condition of their child. Regarding this issue, the committee decided to send letters to both the Ministry of Islamic Affairs and the Maldives Hajj Corporation Limited to obtain information on how the matter was handled. The details of this vote are in the "Votes" section of this page.

meetings.summary: In today’s meeting, Kendhoo Constituency Member Mauroof Zakir proposed to set the deadline for Animal Welfare Bill, Zakath Bill and bill on amendment to the Thalassemia Control Act (no. 4/2012) as 25 th November 2025. This proposal was seconded by Dhaandhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Fazeel. The proposal was passed unanimously by the members present. Next, the committee discussed the Organ Transplant Bill. Dhaandhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Fazeel proposed to meet the officials from Maldivian Thalassemia Society and Maldivian Blood Services. This proposal was seconded by Kaashidho Constituency Member Munthazim Ibrahim. The proposal was passed unanimously by the members present. Then, Committee discussed the resolution submitted by North Galolhu Constituency Member Mohamed Ibrahim to ascertain the views of Members of Parliament on the lack of access to Aasandha healthcare services to foreigners who are married to Maldivians. Dhaandhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Fazeel proposed to open the resolution for public comments until 05 th February 2026. This proposal was seconded by Komandoo Constituency Member Mohamed Ibrahim. The proposal was passed unanimously by the members present. Next, Dhaandhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Fazeel proposed to set the due date of the Resolution as 10 th February 2026. This proposal was seconded by Kaashidhoo Constituency Member Munthazim Ibrahim. The proposal was passed unanimously by the members present. Lastly, the Committee discussed a letter from the Ministry of Health regarding the unavailability of methylphenidate for the treatment of ADHD patients. The Kendhoo Constituency Member Mauroof Zakir proposed to refer the matter to Judiciary Committee, as it is expected to be addressed through the ongoing amendments to the Drugs Act currently under consideration by the Judiciary Committee. This proposal was seconded by Dhaandhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Fazeel. The proposal was passed unanimously by the members present. meetings.title: 14th Meeting 2025
meetings.summary: In today’s meeting, the Committee discussed Animal Welfare Bill. It was brought to the Committee’s attention that there were some variations between the soft and hard copy of the bill, which resulted in difficulties in reviewing the bill. West Maafannu Constituency Member Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim proposed to send a letter to the Attorney General’s Office to clarify the reasons for these variations. North Galolhu Constituency Member Mohamed Ibrahim seconded this proposal. This proposal was passed unanimously by the members present. Then, the Committee proceeded with other matters submitted for its review. While reviewing a matter submitted by an individual regarding a doctor’s conduct at the Hulhumale Hospital, West Maafannu Constituency Member Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim proposed to close the matter as the complainant has not responded to the letter sent on 16 th February 2025, seeking an update on the matter. This proposal was seconded by Komandoo Constituency Member Mohamed Ibrahim. This proposal was passed unanimously by the members present. Next, West Maafannu Constituency Member Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim proposed to send a letter to the Commissioner of Sports to clarify the issue regarding Revival Sports Club. It was seconded by Kaashidhoo Constituency Member Munthazim Ibrahim. This proposal was passed unanimously by the members present. Regarding the same issue, Kaashidhoo Constituency Member Munthazim Ibrahim proposed, and West Maafannu Constituency Member Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim seconded to send a letter to the complainant advising him to proceed with the corruption component of the complaint by filing a complaint as the Anti-Corruption Commission of the Maldives. This proposal was passed unanimously by the members present. Then, the committee discussed the letters sent by private individuals requesting a meeting with the committee to share their concerns about banning vape in the Maldives. As the bill is already passed and vape is banned in the Maldives, North Galolhu Constituency Member Mohamed Ibrahim proposed to respond to those letters accordingly. West Maafannu Constituency Member Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim seconded this proposal. The proposal was passed unanimously by the members present. Next, the committee discussed a letter from an individual concerning the adverse consequences of a surgery performed at Hulhumale Hospital. West Maafannu Constituency Member Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim proposed to meet the complainant. This proposal was seconded by Nilandhoo Constituency Member Fathimath Saudha. The proposal was passed unanimously by the members present. Lastly, West Maafannu Constituency Member Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim proposed to meet State Trading Organization Plc, Aasandha Company Limited and National Social Protection Agency regarding an issue referred by an individual. He also proposed to meet with Male City Group of Hospitals, Aasandha Company Limited and National Social Protection Agency to discuss issues related to healthcare system in the Maldives. This proposal was seconded by Dhaandhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Fazeel. The proposal was passed unanimously by the members present. ﻿ Details of votes taken in this meeting are on “Votes” section of this page.

meetings.title: 22nd Meeting 2024
meetings.summary: In today’s meeting, Committee discussed regarding the amendment bill on Law No 30/2015 (Maldives Sports Act). After much deliberation, North Galolhu Constituency Member Mohamed Ibrahim proposed to set 28 th February 2025 as the deadline for the completion of the bill. Dhaandhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Fazeel supported the proposal. The proposal was passed unanimously. Next, West Maafannu Constituency Member Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim proposed to meet all the stakeholders in the National Sports framework to discuss the bill. South Mahchangolhi Constituency Member Mustafa Hussain seconded this proposal. The proposal was passed unanimously. Lastly, West Maafannu Constituency Member Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim proposed that all administrative formalities regarding the stakeholder meeting should be completed by 15 th January 2025 and to get comments from the public and stakeholders on the bill by 15 th January 2025. South Mahchangolhi Constituency Member Mustafa Hussain seconded this proposal. The proposal was passed unanimously.
